candidate_source_note: The clean exact-source installed wheel contains corrected embedder-close and Tegra install-route landings. Package metadata remains 0.8.26; source and native wheel bytes are authoritative.
candidate_verdict_rule: Descriptive whole-lifecycle comparison only. Report slower/faster close and memory change separately from accepted release gates; version agreement does not prove correctness.
database: Fresh real SQLite database and fresh installed Python process per cycle
invalid_block_rule: Preserve all attempts. Require verified wheel/native/source/runner bytes, exactly 20 valid measured cycles and one valid warmup, semantic and reopen assertions, stable host/kernel/CPU/storage/governor/toolchain, no named competing jobs, at least 1 GiB free and zero child swap. Host-only swap drift is a warning with sensitivity. Do not replace a slow valid sample.
memory_boundary: Linux smaps_rollup RSS, PSS and private memory before open, after model use, immediately after close, after 200 ms closed idle and after handle drop
memory_rule: Report PSS, RSS and private opened-to-closed-idle deltas for both versions; allocator retention means memory counters are diagnostic. A close-time increase must be interpreted together with memory release and the focused ownership/deadlock oracle.
percentile_rule: Sort all valid per-version samples; nearest-rank index ceil(p*n)-1, without trimming. Report each block median and complete range.
revision_reason: The original lifecycle campaign/auditor hardcoded the older integrated wheel path. Preflight rejected the exact wheel before output creation or timing. This refreeze binds exact-source runner and auditor bytes; workload, schedule, baseline pilot, source and wheel hashes are unchanged.
scope: Installed Python default-embedder open/close lifecycle on exact source 224e44c59; subset of Phase 1
timing_boundary: Engine.close invocation to return with the closed Python engine handle retained
uncertainty_rule: Report each of the five pair deltas, their median and complete range; do not claim significance or equivalence.
